description: This file defines the NetworkConfigChangedEvent class, which extends Event and represents an event indicating that the network configuration has changed. It includes a constructor that sets the event name and a method that returns a placeholder base64-encoded network configuration data string.

classes.name: NetworkConfigChangedEvent
classes.description: A class representing a network configuration change event, extending the Event class and providing a method to retrieve network configuration data.

methods.name: NetworkConfigChangedEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with the name 'networkConfigChanged'.

methods.name: getNetworkConfigData
methods.description: Returns a placeholder base64-encoded string representing network configuration data.
